**About this dashboard** — Live observability data from a production-pattern EKS cluster running the OpenTelemetry Demo application. Dashboard is for Demonstration purposes, production environment dashboards should be more portable and tailored to specific usecases.

**Design notes:** SLO burn-rate windows compressed (5m/1h fast, 30m/3h slow) for demo purposes. Alerting follows the [Google SRE multi-window multi-burn-rate](https://sre.google/workbook/alerting-on-slos/) approach. Monitoring-as-a-service pattern: services opt into alert coverage via pod labels (`slo-errorbudget`, `pod-health`, `team`) rather than hardcoded rules.

Source: [creechlabs-terraform / Helm Values](https://github.com/rosej904/creechlabs-terraform/blob/main/environments/portfolio/argocd/apps/grafana/values.yaml) · Stack: EKS · Prometheus · Loki · Tempo · Grafana · OpenTelemetry

spec.expr: (1 - (sum by (device, node) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node", mountpoint="/", fstype!="tmpfs"}) / (sum by (device, node) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{node=~"$node", mountpoint="/", fstype!="tmpfs"})))) * 100
